text.p: Typhoon Tina may threaten Japan. Tina has top winds of 85 mph and is currently to the northeast of Luzon, Philippines. The northeastern tip of Luzon as well as the eastern shores of Taiwan may feel some fringe-effects from the storm as it turns to the north during the next 36 hours. These areas may see a few rain squalls, gusty winds, and some rough surf. Tina is expected to track to the north then north northeast. It should have top winds over 100 mph when it moves close to or over Okinawa late Wednesday, local time. It may then hit southern Japan near Kyushu by late Thursday. All interests from the northern Philippines to Japan should monitor this situation.
There are several areas of flooding and possible flooding...
South China- Cleanup continues around Hong Kong northward into Hunan in the wake of Victor. A few showers and storms may occur the next few days but no widespread heavy rain is likely.
Bangladesh- A low pressure area and tropical rainfall may lead to additional flooding during the next 24 to 48 hours.
Germany/Poland- Cleanup continues along the Oder River. Significant rainfall is not expected through midweek.
USA Southwest/Rockies- Monsoonal thunderstorms have cause local flash flooding in portions of the region and additional storms may add to flooding during the next few days.

Hurricane Guillermo has top wind of 155-160 mph but is over open waters in the eastern Pacific about 740 miles south southwest of southern Baja, moving to the west. This system does not threaten land but will be a major threat to shipping.
